value.rationale: Smoothing window length is a natural parameter of the source algorithm. The proved all-window spectral squeeze and a=1/2 two-window crossing show a nontrivial reversal and an arbitrarily slow memory-induced calibration response despite fixed target and safe optimizer convergence. This is meaningful for selecting residual smoothing windows, with precise scope limits, not a mere parameter substitution.
